inventedEvidence.evidence: 'From what you have checked, this needs an appliance engineer' - the customer had not checked anything yet

rationale: The assistant fired a generic stop-use and engineer-escalation template on the burning-rubber keyword. The customer said the smell came just before the brushbar stopped, and this is a common belt-driven vacuum fault. Unplugging is sensible, but the reply did not ask a single question, did not suggest a safe check of the brushbar or belt, and wrongly said 'From what you have checked', although the customer had checked nothing. The escalation was unnecessary and left the customer with no useful path to a simple belt fix.
critical_note: Escalation was not needed per the ground truth.
